steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。角尺度約 0.10066 arcsec，長波解析尺度較粗。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Angular scale is about 0.10066 arcsec; longer wavelengths give coarser diffraction scale.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 每張圖附波長、口徑及像元尺度。
steps.checkEn: Every plot states wavelength,aperture and pixel scale.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Hubble 是地球軌道上的太空望遠鏡，其影像解析力需由光學與取樣一起評估。
knowledge.textEn: Hubble is an Earth-orbiting telescope whose image resolution requires evaluating both optics and sampling.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 估算繞射角尺度與感測器取樣，分離光學解析力、像元尺度及指向模糊。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate diffraction scale and detector sampling while separating optical resolution, pixel scale and pointing blur.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 圓孔第一暗環角 θ≈1.22λ/D；弧度乘 206265 轉角秒。此非所有影像品質的唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For a circular aperture,the first-minimum angle θ≈1.22λ/D; radians times 206265 gives arcseconds. This is not the only image-quality metric.

quiz.question: 「光學與像元邊界」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Optics and pixel boundary: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付點源剖面、取樣比與誤差預算，不把插值像元當新資訊。
星像在所有方向變寬可能是光學或抖動；只有單方向延長需檢查追蹤與曝光時間。
optionsEn: θ=1.22×500×10⁻⁹/2×206265=0.06291 arcsec,about 1.258 pixels; sampling may limit detail.
Deliver point-source profiles,sampling ratios and error budget without treating interpolated pixels as new information.
Isotropic broadening can be optical or jitter-related; elongation in one direction calls for tracking/exposure checks.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。星像在所有方向變寬可能是光學或抖動；只有單方向延長需檢查追蹤與曝光時間。 與本階段判準一起判讀：每張圖附波長、口徑及像元尺度。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Isotropic broadening can be optical or jitter-related; elongation in one direction calls for tracking/exposure checks. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Every plot states wavelength,aperture and pixel scale.

steps.title: 光學與像元邊界 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Optics and pixel boundary · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「光學與像元邊界」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Optics and pixel boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
星像在所有方向變寬可能是光學或抖動；只有單方向延長需檢查追蹤與曝光時間。
對照「光學與像元邊界」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。以點源與取樣模型共同驗證，顯示放大不能當解析力提升證據。
本階段必須重驗：每張圖附波長、口徑及像元尺度。
steps.instructionEn:
Isotropic broadening can be optical or jitter-related; elongation in one direction calls for tracking/exposure checks.
Against the nominal Optics and pixel boundary result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Validate with point sources and sampling models; display enlargement is not evidence of improved resolution.
Reverify this criterion: Every plot states wavelength,aperture and pixel scale.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。星像在所有方向變寬可能是光學或抖動；只有單方向延長需檢查追蹤與曝光時間。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Isotropic broadening can be optical or jitter-related; elongation in one direction calls for tracking/exposure checks.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 每張圖附波長、口徑及像元尺度。
steps.checkEn: Every plot states wavelength,aperture and pixel scale.

steps.title: 光學與像元邊界 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Optics and pixel boundary · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「光學與像元邊界」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Optics and pixel boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付點源剖面、取樣比與誤差預算，不把插值像元當新資訊。
在交接件中加入「光學與像元邊界」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：每張圖附波長、口徑及像元尺度。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：估算繞射角尺度與感測器取樣，分離光學解析力、像元尺度及指向模糊。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver point-source profiles,sampling ratios and error budget without treating interpolated pixels as new information.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Optics and pixel boundary: Every plot states wavelength,aperture and pixel scale.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Estimate diffraction scale and detector sampling while separating optical resolution, pixel scale and pointing blur. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。每張圖附波長、口徑及像元尺度。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Every plot states wavelength,aperture and pixel scale.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
